Defunct: download ACS data in the pre-2022 sequence-file format

Source: R/deprecated.R
get_acs_old.Rd

get_acs_old() and the entire sequence-file code path were removed in ACSdownload 3.0.0. Use get_acs_new(), which reads the Census Bureau's table-based summary file format (available for end year 2022 and later).

Usage

get_acs_old(...)

Arguments

...

ignored

Value

This function always stops with an error.

Details

If you specifically need the old sequence-file format for an end year of 2021 or earlier, install the final 2.x release: remotes::install_github("ejanalysis/ACSdownload@v2.4.0-pre-refactor").
